comfyui-media-feed_placement.name: Placement
comfyui-media-feed_placement.tooltip: Choose where the floating Media Feed panel appears.

comfyui-media-feed_follow-latest.name: Follow latest media
comfyui-media-feed_follow-latest.tooltip: Automatically scroll the feed to newly generated media.

comfyui-media-feed_exclude-preview-media.name: Exclude Preview node media
comfyui-media-feed_exclude-preview-media.tooltip: Do not add media emitted by Preview nodes, such as Preview Image, to the feed.

comfyui-media-feed_feed-style.name: Feed style
comfyui-media-feed_feed-style.tooltip: Choose the standard feed or a frameless feed that keeps the on-panel size control while hiding other panel chrome.

comfyui-media-feed_media-scope.name: Media from
comfyui-media-feed_media-scope.tooltip: Show media from every workflow tab or only media queued from the currently active workflow tab.

comfyui-media-feed_batch-dividers.name: Batch dividers
comfyui-media-feed_batch-dividers.tooltip: Show a visual separator when adjacent media came from different queued generations.

comfyui-media-feed_show-prompts.name: Show metadata in viewer
comfyui-media-feed_show-prompts.tooltip: Read embedded PNG, GIF, MP4, WebM, M4A, MP3, FLAC, OGG, or Opus metadata and show inferred prompt and seed metadata when viewing media.

comfyui-media-feed_metadata-position.name: Metadata position
comfyui-media-feed_metadata-position.tooltip: Choose which side of the viewer shows prompt and metadata details.

comfyui-media-feed_scale-viewer-media.name: Fit media to viewer
comfyui-media-feed_scale-viewer-media.tooltip: Fit images and videos to the available viewer area.

comfyui-media-feed_loop-videos.name: Loop videos
comfyui-media-feed_loop-videos.tooltip: Loop video playback in feed previews and the viewer.

comfyui-media-feed_loop-audio.name: Loop audio
comfyui-media-feed_loop-audio.tooltip: Loop audio playback in feed cards and the viewer.

comfyui-media-feed_show-favorite-button.name: Show favorite button on hover
comfyui-media-feed_show-favorite-button.tooltip: Show the favorite star in the upper-right corner of a feed card when you hover over it.

comfyui-media-feed_favorite-folder.name: Favorite storage folder
comfyui-media-feed_favorite-folder.tooltip: Favorites are always stored in the output/favorites folder and this location cannot be changed.
